Research note carried from the epic's experiment (origin/main 083620b0): 30 of the 34 library functions' return annotations name `rebar.types` TypedDicts imported only under `TYPE_CHECKING`, so `inspect.signature(fn, eval_str=True)` (which FastMCP's `func_metadata` calls) raises `NameError` on them. That is expected and is NOT something this story fixes: the derivation story's factory resolves hints itself with `typing.get_type_hints(fn, globalns=vars(sys.modules[fn.__module__]), localns=vars(rebar.types))` and never hands FastMCP a library function directly. The `test_repo_root_annotation_is_uniform` test in this story must therefore use `typing.get_type_hints(..., localns=vars(rebar.types))`, not `inspect.signature(eval_str=True)`.

Cross-epic note: the two typed sinks widened here (`_lib_warn.py:44`, `_commands/cross_session.py:33`) are not edited by any other epic in this release.
